name: overwhelmed
description: Not knowing how to respond to too many demands or too much stimulation.

variations.name: feeling out of control
variations.description: An uncomfortable sense that events have spiraled out of your control.

variations.name: too much to process
variations.description: When hit with a completely unexpected event you may not know how to respond.

commentaries.quote: Dealing with the complications of modern life can strain your ability to keep up with it: bills, appointments, home ownership, parenthood, spam, avoiding scams, traffic, making ends meet, relationships. It all adds up. Consider taking one thing at a time.

conditions: Environmental demands are greater than you perceive you can handle
